integrity: The Hessian, gradient, sidelobes, kernel, and characteristic polynomial are derived from the stated autocorrelation functional. Exact replay uses arithmetic in Z[zeta] and an exact integer determinant; no numerical optimization is used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is local. It proves strict local minimality modulo the two continuous phase symmetries but does not prove that base energy 5 is globally minimal among all length-six unimodular sequences, and it does not classify all base-energy critical points.
title: Exact transverse Hessian of the length-six Barker code
